messages:
elaine: quick check — planning to enable flag `rerank_v2` for a seed canary (0.5%) at 09:30 PT. intended audience: random users, exclude orgs with dedicated capacity. guardrails: p95_gen_latency, cart_conv. reply if this conflicts with any experiments or rollout windows.

mike: +1 on the plan. one ask: please exclude `ui_beta` and `internal_support` cohorts — we saw overlap skew CTR last time.

shivani: noted. what's the precise stop rule? i can add grafana alerts and a PagerDuty runbook.

elaine: stop if p95_gen_latency increases >20ms vs baseline OR cart_conv drops >2 percentage points absolute. also auto-fail open after 5m if error_rate > 1%.

ara: can run an overlap query against active experiment assignments — ETA ~12m. will post numbers.

pm-zoe: product ask: also track `topk_click_share` delta, make sure absolute change < 0.5 percentage points.

mike: config snippet i'll use for the flag rollout:
```json
{
  "flag": "rerank_v2",
  "audiences": [{"name":"canary","percent":0.5}, {"name":"ramp1","percent":5}],
  "exclusions": ["ui_beta","internal_support","dedicated_accounts"],
  "metrics": ["p95_gen_latency","cart_conv","topk_click_share"],
  "stop_rules": {"p95_delta_ms": 20, "cart_conv_drop_pp": 2},
  "fail_open_after_mins": 5
}
```

release-bot: deploy scheduled — job #11827 started: https://deploys.redwood/jobs/11827 :rocket:

shivani: i'll wire alerts: add Grafana panels + slack alerts to #incidents and #eng-platform-canary. thresholds: p95 baseline=180ms, alert at >=200ms; cart_conv baseline=5.6%, alert <3.6%.

elaine: plan on ramp: seed 0.5% for 24h, if guardrails pass then 5% for 24h, then evaluate for broader rollout. stable hashing for user assignment please (no mid-session flips).

ara: overlap query complete — results: of the targeted 0.5% canary, 0.12% are in `ui_beta`, 0.03% in `internal_support`. will patch exclusion lists and re-run to confirm.

mike: thanks — also make sure sampling uses per-user consistent hashing (seeded by user_id) so we don't reassign on refresh.

shivani: alerts configured and playbook doc updated: https://wiki.redwood/inference/canary-playbook (sections: detection, rollback, postmortem template). i'll also add an automated snapshot of evaluation prompts at 1h and 6h.

elaine: no objections raised — i'm going to push the flag at 09:30 PT. if anyone has last-minute conflicts speak now.

pm-zoe: :thumbsup: go ahead.

release-bot: deployment finished — canary enabled for `rerank_v2` at 0.5% (job #11827). health check: ok.

ara: updated overlap after exclusions: ui_beta overlap -> 0.01%, internal_support -> 0.0%. good to proceed.

elaine: thanks all — monitoring dashboards are live, will post a short summary at 10:30 PT with early metrics.

mike: ping me if we need a fast rollback, i'll stand by.

shivani: copy — will escalate if any guardrail trips.

release-bot: note: automated rollback will trigger if `p95_gen_latency` > baseline +20ms for 5 continuous minutes or `cart_conv` drops >2pp in a rolling 30min window.
